items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He wrote a clarinet concerto for me, called the Jimmy and I Concerto... So he wrote the Jimmy and I Concerto for me that I premier here in New York.

ctx.x: And what was the repertoire, was it your music?

Some of my music compositions, but by Chucho Valdés also, and some composition by Carlo Francetti, who was a great composer. This piano player from Argentina, a very talented player, but he is also a very Bill Evans oriented player, but he is also a good composer and arranger. He wrote a clarinet concerto for me, called the Jimmy and I Concerto because he was born June 3rd and I was born June 4th, the same year. So he wrote the Jimmy and I Concerto for me that I premier here in New York.
Did you find at that point your writing was increasing?
